closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, magnesium, and unusually protein-forward for a seed snack, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low starch, and low calcium. It is good for muscles and strength sports, bone health, and immune support because the protein section supports repair and maintenance, magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, and zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
